change: Add an Along a curve mode to the chain rule workshop: step t and read dy/dx as (dy/dt) ÷ (dx/dt).

mutations.name: the slope upside down
mutations.find: s(){ const a=this.a(), b=this.b(); return a[0]===0 ? null : this.frac(b[0]*a[1], b[1]*a[0]); },
mutations.replace: s(){ const a=this.a(), b=this.b(); return a[0]===0 ? null : this.frac(a[0]*b[1], a[1]*b[0]); },

mutations.name: the point worked over the wrong bottom
mutations.find: for(const [c,p] of P) s+=c*k**p*2**(D-p); return this.frac(s, 2**D); },
mutations.replace: for(const [c,p] of P) s+=c*k**p*2**(D-p); return this.frac(s, 2**D+1); },

mutations.name: backwards never said
mutations.find: return `${v} moves ${m==='1' ? 'as fast as' : m+' times as fast as'} t${f[0]<0 ? ', backwards' : ''}`;
mutations.replace: return `${v} moves ${m==='1' ? 'as fast as' : m+' times as fast as'} t${''}`;

mutations.name: straight up told as a dead stop
one pass counts as the crossing
the stepper goes past t = 2
mutations.find: if(v<this.KLO || v>this.KHI) return; this.k=v; this.touched=true; Chain.render();
mutations.replace: if(v<this.KLO || v>this.KHI+1) return; this.k=v; this.touched=true; Chain.render();

mutations.name: the crossing counted before a press
the nudge takes y one way
y drawn to its own scale
